fib: ______ is the increase in the stock of real capital in an economy (Ahuja, 2016).
Capital formation
Capital formation is the increase in the stock of real capital in an economy (Ahuja, 2016).
______ is a commitment to social progress, economic growth and environmental balance which are often referred to as the 3 pillars of stainable development.
Sustainable development
Sustainable development is a commitment to social progress, economic growth and environmental balance which are often referred to as the 3 pillars of stainable development.
______ is an economic growth model explaining the long-run economic growth within the neoclassical economies.
Solow-Swan model
The Solow-Swan model is an economic growth model explaining the long-run economic growth within the neoclassical economies.
______ is an economy with weak economic and development base.
underdeveloped economy
An underdeveloped economy is an economy with weak economic and development base.
______ is a reflection of low productivity which is mainly caused by insufficient capital.
low real income
The low real income is a reflection of low productivity which is mainly caused by insufficient capital.
______ is the coexistence of an advanced imported capitalist system and an indigenous pre-capitalist backward system.
Domestic dualism
Domestic dualism is the coexistence of an advanced imported capitalist system and an indigenous pre-capitalist backward system.
______ is a broad measure of aggregate economic activity which can be calculated using three different approaches.
Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
Gross Domestic Product
GDP
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a broad measure of aggregate economic activity which can be calculated using three different approaches.
______ is a model of structural change because it outlines the development from a traditional economy to an industrialized one.
Lewis model
The Lewis model is a model of structural change because it outlines the development from a traditional economy to an industrialized one.
______ is a trade strategy in which there is bias of incentive towards production of import substitutes (Metu et al., 2018).
Export promotion strategy
Export promotion strategy is a trade strategy in which there is bias of incentive towards production of import substitutes (Metu et al., 2018).
______ is the increased application of new scientific knowledge in the form of inventions and innovations with regard to both physical and human capital.
Technological progress
Technological progress is the increased application of new scientific knowledge in the form of inventions and innovations with regard to both physical and human capital.
